decisions.reason: The mitred door lever handle family builds directly on the firm's core metal, ergonomic, and finishing expertise, so it can be interpreted and improved rather than dropped.
Its move to a dedicated page indicates the firm is assimilating early results and applying its existing multifunctional hardware knowledge, supporting retention.
As a door lever handle close to the firm's established product families and in-house manufacturing, it falls well within existing absorptive capacity.
Strong quantified results and a dedicated page show successful commercial application of closely related design and engineering knowledge, making a drop very unlikely.
